english-language.wchoice.029.all: Plan. (a) Online magazine article, semi-formal persuasive: case for zoos (conservation, breeding programmes, education, research) vs against (welfare, captivity, small enclosures); alternatives such as documentaries, sanctuaries, virtual reality; clear stance, rhetorical devices, strong conclusion. (b) Guide for first-time visitors on a travel website: engaging, informative, headed sections, main attractions, things to do, transport and food tips, accurate and welcoming tone. AO4 27 + AO5 18 = 45.

english-language.wchoice.051.all: Plan. (a) Formal letter to editor (Dear Sir/Madam, Yours faithfully): reasons parents set rules (safety, exams), how much freedom teens need (trust, independence), balanced view, clear opinion. (b) School magazine article 'Village or City?': village attractions (community, nature, safety) vs city (jobs, culture, transport), engaging tone for teen readers, conclusion. AO4 27 + AO5 18 = 45.

english-language.wchoice.059.all: Plan. (a) Formal letter to headteacher: view on ending foreign-language lessons after 14; effects on students (careers, skills, workload) and school (timetable, staffing); alternatives (optional clubs, exchange visits, apps). (b) Persuasive leaflet for households: why saving water matters (shortages, bills, climate); practical tips (shorter showers, fix leaks, water butts); headings, imperatives, direct address. AO4 27 + AO5 18 = 45.
